exam_facts.note: Class C Knowledge Test, physical p10 (printed 2): 'It has 35 multiple-choice questions. You must answer 28 questions correctly to receive a passing score.' The manual states the standard as 28 of 35 correct; 80 percent is that exact ratio (28/35), not a separately printed percentage. No time limit is stated (null, not imported from memory). Printed page = physical - 8 in the body (extractor reports no printed id). Physical p8 states the manual only addresses the Class C non-commercial driving privilege.
